blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Sen. Robin Padilla on Tuesday urged the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) to “pressure” the House of Representatives to meet and discuss with the Senate the Freedom of Information (FOI) bill. The Senate approved in May its version of the bill, while its counterpart measure was passed by the House in June. Read: Senate
